entries.description: Hanzo's API as MCP tools at https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/mcp (streamable HTTP): one tool per capability, its operations named by an argument. Models, agents, storage, compute and the rest of the API, with the caller's own credential.
representativeQueries: call frontier language models through one MCP server
give my agent tools for storage, compute and model inference
connect an MCP client to Hanzo's API

entries.description: Hanzo's assistant over A2A (JSON-RPC at https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/agent/a2a): it answers with Hanzo's cloud as its tools, acting with the caller's own credential.
representativeQueries: ask an agent to run a task on Hanzo's cloud
delegate a request to Hanzo's assistant over A2A

entries.description: The OpenAPI document for https://api.hanzo.ai/v1: one base URL and one key for every model, agent and service. OpenAI-compatible chat completions.
representativeQueries: OpenAI-compatible API for many models with one key
the REST API reference for Hanzo

entries.description: RFC 9727 API catalog: each Hanzo API with its description, documentation, OAuth metadata and status page.
representativeQueries: where is Hanzo's API documentation and status page

entries.description: What Hanzo Cloud serves and how to call it, written for an agent working in someone else's codebase.
representativeQueries: teach my coding agent how to call Hanzo's API
what can Hanzo Cloud do and how do I authenticate
